ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web with labels including Meadow Grasses, Rabbit, Deer, Vole, Coyote, and Hawk. In the diagram, an arrow goes from Rabbit to Coyote, showing that the coyote eats rabbits. Reasoning: In this food web, arrows go from food or prey to the consumer or predator. If rabbits become extinct, coyotes lose rabbits as a food source. With less food available, the coyote population will decrease.
